name: MetaForge Controller API
description: Bounded OpenAPI tool surface for Open WebUI control and verification.

tool_groups.description: Safe inspection tools. No state mutation.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Return a 24-hour runtime, log, artifact, and verification summary for the MetaForge controller.

tools.name: recent_output
tools.description: Return the recent controller output summary with log evidence and artifact freshness.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Return a high-level runtime, queue, verification, and artifact snapshot.

tools.name: runtime_summary
tools.description: Return the current runtime summary, epoch, control center, task counts, and verification status.

tools.name: control_status
tools.description: Return control center and queue pause state.

tools.name: queue_status
tools.description: Return task queue counts and pending tasks.

tools.name: tasks_pending
tools.description: Return the current pending and waiting approval tasks.

tools.name: verification_status
tools.description: Return verification, release gate, runtime health, tool health, and AI testing status.

tools.name: artifacts_recent
tools.description: Return a summary of recent artifacts and evidence freshness.

tool_groups.description: Bounded writes that update controller state or task decisions.

tools.name: goal_activate
tools.description: Activate a goal in controller state.

tools.name: task_approve
tools.description: Approve a task and return it to queued state.

tools.name: task_reject
tools.description: Reject a task and mark it cancelled.

tools.name: repair_schedule
tools.description: Schedule a bounded repair request for follow-up execution.

tool_groups.description: Confirmation-gated endpoints. Only use with explicit human confirmation.

open_webui_setup_notes: Register as a Global Tool Server for shared/admin access.
Use controller-api:8710 when Open WebUI and the controller share the same Docker network.
Use host.docker.internal when Open WebUI runs in Docker on Windows but the controller runs on the host.
Keep the MetaForge Controller API separate from the main orchestrator control plane.
Prefer read-only tools for first-time validation.
